title: Narwhalswap (BSC) — live extraction assessment of a dead PancakeSwap-V2 fork
closed_reasons: Pairs (all 96): V2 accounting intact, reserves == balances on the 3 funded pairs; only 7 positions with raw excess, all reflection/fee-token dust (<$0.001 realizable); skim on funded pairs pays 0 wei.

NAR/WBNB pair: LP-holder claims only; 80.383% of LP is in NLPLock whose withdraw() is onlyOwner (team) and reverts for outsiders; NAR charges 2.5%+2.5% tax per transfer (1 WBNB round trip loses 10.24%).
WBNB/THUGS pair: Narwhal pair is not whitelisted in ThugsToken; dynamic 5-50% burn (live 33.49%) applies on both buys and sells; 0.5 WBNB round trip loses 55.9%.

Farms (V1/V2/V3/tier/Dividend): withdraw requires own staked _balances + rNLP (or nard) + allowance; seize() is onlyGovernance; buffRateReporter victim-condition unreachable on all live stakers; updateBuffRate reverts (uint8 loop) for fresh/old accounts; reward pots ~99.2% allocated to existing stakers.
NarwhalCollecter.convert() is permissionless but pays the caller nothing (burns its own fee-LP into permanently-locked NAR/BNB LP); total Collecter value ~$55, not payable to anyone.
NAR mint gated by 3 minters/team (calls revert '!minter'); only 284,832 NAR mintable left under cap; farm mints are dust to the farm itself.
rNLP mint gated by the farms ('!minter'); factory setFeeTo only feeToSetter (team).
THUGS TWAP-manip to 0.5% burn floor yields at most +0.3%/round trip vs the BSCSwap pool (1.3% price gap) - no material extraction.
key_facts: CI-verified (run 38269314749, block 127,233,623): 95/96 pairs read, same 7 dust-excess pairs, factory/locker/farm values identical, keccak(pair creationCode)==factory.pairCodeHash, forge 13/13 PASS.

All farm/dividend LP withdrawals are gated by the caller's own accounting; most historical stakers additionally need a one-time rNLP approve (allowances are 0 for 17/20 top stakers).
Excess scan (all 96 pairs): 7 dust positions, largest 10,548,636 PBANK in 0xc2b0fec1 (that pair's whole WBNB side = 0.00163 WBNB); total realizable < $0.001; skim on the 3 funded pairs = 0 wei.
NAR token: mint remaining 284,832.04 under 21M cap; burn pool 0x7777 holds 11,098,868.48 NAR (never sent out); team can seize all farm non-LP tokens.
PoC 13/13 fork tests green (local block 127,227,511): incl. NAR round trip -10.24%, THUGS round trip -55.9%, locker/collecter/farm/mint gates.
caveats: NAR-denominated USD uses the Narwhal pool-implied price ($0.024779) which is circular; H-O includes $42,016 of NAR pots at that price but NAR exit liquidity is only the pool's 181.45 WBNB for the whole 14M supply. H-O hard-side alone is $118,335 (H-O + NAR pots = $160,351).
P is the NLPLock WBNB-side ($108,438); the locker's NAR side (4.376M) is excluded from the category totals to avoid circular double counting. A full team exit (burn LP + dump NAR) nets ~$129k.
Key possession for team EOA 0xb104AE8b, dormant LP EOA 0x4d710603 and 0x7777 cannot be verified on-chain; P/S classification there is assumption-based and disclosed.
11.1M NAR parked at 0x7777777777777777777777777777777777777777 is P if the team holds that key, S if destroyed; not counted in categories.
Excess dust (PBANK/HYPR/COM) is reflection/fee accrual to stale pairs and drifts block-to-block but stays near-zero value.
GoldRush was used only for holder discovery; every material balance was re-read directly via RPC and reconciled to supply (deltas <0.32% from indexer gaps for dust holders).
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0.00 live (high confidence): all 96 V2 pairs are reserve-fair with only <$0.001 reflection dust, LP claims are LP-gated (80.4% of the top pair's LP is a team-only locker), farm/dividend withdrawals require the caller's own staked balances, the feeTo collector pays nobody, and NAR's 5% transfer tax plus THUGS' 33.5% dynamic burn make every round trip a loss (fork-verified 13/13).
